test_keep_alive_argument: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on method arguments to verify child objects are kept alive by the parent
test_keep_alive_return_value: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on return values to verify returned child objects stay alive
test_alive_gc: test keep_alive behavior with garbage collection when circular references are present
test_call_guard: test the pybind11 call_guard policy to verify mutex and GIL locking behavior
test_keep_alive_constructor: test the pybind11 keep_alive policy on constructors to verify child arguments are kept alive by the constructed parent
